children: US broadband holding company's Q3 revenue fell 3.8% yr/yr due to lower service revenues
Company posted Q3 net loss versus profit a year earlier
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future periods in the press release
SERVICE REVENUE DECLINE - Co said Q3 revenue fell due to lower service revenues, mainly from reduced installation activity versus prior year
OTHER INCOME DROP - Co said decrease in other income was mainly due to lower equity in earnings of affiliates and reduced yields on U.S. Treasuries
ONE-TIME EXPENSE CREDIT - Co said a one-time non-regulated expense credit partially offset lower EBITDA from operations
